question: Can finite-prior intervention selection acquire hidden nonlinear causes rather than merely scaling affine tables?
hypothesis: Entropy-selected state interventions identify unknown conjunctions of degree 2 or 3 with fewer observations than random probes, supporting direct numerical construction, unseen-state action prediction and composition. Two-conjunction XOR and degree4 falsify a single-degree<=3 structural prior. This is bounded hypothesis selection, not autonomous invention of primitives.
world: Each action cyclically rotates the binary state by action+1 and XORs its hidden nonlinear Boolean residual into output bit0. Hidden support is sampled uniformly without exposing seed/family/support to learners. Pair/triple/quartic is AND on sampled support; xor_pairs is XOR of two distinct sampled pair-ANDs. Rotation is explicitly given structural background, not acquired.
learner: Candidate masks enumerate all nonempty subsets degree<=3; active query greedily balances surviving hypotheses over all-ones, single-coordinate deletions and 24 deterministic pseudorandom states (density .5/.75/.875). Queries never repeated; ties by numeric query. Remaining candidate lexicographic minimum is written as 0/1 connection weights and AND threshold. Empty version space uses residual0 and reports contradiction. Runtime uses stored numeric conjunction plus given rotation.
trained_control: Analytical minimum-norm ordinary least-squares fit using two-pass modified Gram-Schmidt on observed feature vectors. Feature prior same monomial dictionary incl constant, multiple coefficients allowed. Check convergence on supplied labels and report failures/residual. This is a fully fitted conventional linear feature model, not a neural baseline nor matched architecture capacity.

tests.retention: snapshot before training second independent world, exact cold replay after, reject corruption
tests.repair: one witnessed nonlinear-residual contradiction can eliminate candidates; score before/after, no hidden support access

metrics: construction and inference seconds separately by arm
source, tree, Python, OS, total wall time

classification.engineering: all deterministic unit/regression tests plus source atlas and clean tree Windows/Linux; identical integer scores and trace across OS; no hidden-label leakage
classification.bounded_support: pair/triple active12 >=95% exact heldout states, >=90% composition and plans, >=90% unique identification, >=5 percentage point gain over random4 on heldout; compare active4 vs random4 separately. Strong same-transcript control must agree exactly.
classification.negative: Preserve all OOD misses and ambiguity. Report OOD fractions even if accidentally represented on observed states.
classification.science: No independent SCIENTIFIC_PASS without unseen-domain independent replication, matched strongest neural controls and all-in cost. Classify DEV_SUPPORTED/MIXED/SCIENTIFIC_NEGATIVE based on preset bounded thresholds; strong-control tie is no direct-programming superiority.

authority: Isolated contributor draft, bounded public synthetic DEV/PRIMARY and established hosted CI only. No merge/main/accepted refs, official loop, private runner, controllers, live actions or deployment.
